alpha_finance.source_feed: Coinglass, per Alpha Finance methodology page
limitations: No issuer-level holdings, fund AUM or fee series published on this dashboard.
Its methodology page identifies Coinglass as the ETF dashboard feed; this is not an issuer-primary flow feed.
The visible daily table omits Oct 30 and Nov 2 even though the stated window runs Oct 27 to Nov 6; omission is not evidence of zero.
The dashboard itself warns that zero and missing are different and that net flows can lag creations/redemptions.

xrp_insights.method: daily delta in issuer-reported XRP holdings; not an issuer-reported AP creation/redemption file

excluded_or_special_cases.GXRP: Flow excluded across the full history because the issuer page blocked automated reads from 2026-09-02 through 2026-09-28; holdings and AUM remain in totals.
excluded_or_special_cases.BITW: Multi-asset index fund; XRP sleeve changes with monthly index rebalancing, so its holding change is not pure single-asset ETF creation/redemption.
excluded_or_special_cases.XRPR: Issuer page shows part of exposure held through CoinShares Physical XRP ETP; classify indirect ETP exposure separately from direct XRP custody.
excluded_or_special_cases.reconstructed_rows: 2026-03-23 to 2026-03-27; 2026-03-31 to 2026-04-29; 2026-05-12 reconstructed from third-party estimates; exclude from observed-only training.
excluded_or_special_cases.timing: Issuer NAV/holdings publish overnight and can be re-settled next morning; latest rows can be provisional and revised.
excluded_or_special_cases.non_creation_changes: Holdings changes caused by index rebalancing or fees paid in XRP may be counted as flow.

reasons: Alpha covers XRP, XRPZ, XRPC, GXRP and TOXR; XRP Insights covers XRPC, XRP, XRPR, XRPZ, GXRP, TOXR and BITW.
Alpha's methodology names Coinglass; XRP Insights derives daily changes from issuer-reported holdings.
XRP Insights excludes GXRP flow but includes GXRP holdings; Alpha includes GXRP in its five-fund flow universe.
XRP Insights includes XRPR and BITW; BITW is multi-asset and XRPR has an indirect CoinShares ETP sleeve.
The windows and units differ: Alpha reports USD 7/30-session and cumulative flows; XRP Insights reports a one-week XRP holdings delta converted approximately to USD.
XRP Insights has reconstructed historical rows and warns that holdings changes can include non-creation effects.
Alpha's displayed daily rows omit Oct 30 and Nov 2; their status is unknown from the rendered table.
reconciliation.conclusion: The reported +$8.4M Alpha seven-session flow and -813K XRP XRP Insights weekly holdings delta are not directly contradictory. They describe different fund universes, data sources, windows and flow definitions. Do not average, net or combine them. Keep separate provider-specific series and flags until a same-fund, same-date, settled, issuer-source reconciliation is built.

model_feature_policy.alpha_series: secondary_provider_flow_usd; low confidence; provider-specific; no holdings validation
model_feature_policy.xrp_insights_series: issuer_holdings_delta_proxy; exclude reconstructed rows; isolate BITW and XRPR; GXRP flow unavailable
model_feature_policy.primary_feature_needed: per-fund settled issuer-reported XRP holdings and AP creation/redemption data with exact source timestamps

custody_and_exposure_notes.XRPZ: Franklin's indexed issuer page reports Coinbase Custody Trust Company as XRP custodian and BNY as administrator, transfer agent and cash custodian; displayed holdings/AUM dates are September 4/7, not November 6.
custody_and_exposure_notes.XRPR: REX-Osprey indexed issuer page as of October 1 reports 60.05% direct XRP and 39.90% CoinShares Physical XRP ETP; do not treat all exposure as direct XRP custody.
custody_and_exposure_notes.TOXR: 21Shares indexed issuer page names Anchorage Digital Bank, BitGo Bank & Trust and Coinbase Custody International as custodians; indexed net-assets figure lacks a reliable as-of date.
custody_and_exposure_notes.BITW: Bitwise describes BITW as a diversified 10-asset index product with monthly rebalancing; its XRP sleeve is not equivalent to a dedicated XRP ETF.

signatories: Scott Baugess, Vice President, Global Regulatory Policy
coinbase_letter.position: supports much of the covered-investment-contract offering framework; requests explicit treatment that an aftermarket purchase from an unaffiliated holder without assigned issuer-contract rights is not an investment contract/securities transaction; seeks clarity on post-functionality activity

ripple_letter.position: supports the interpretive direction but requests further guidance on common enterprise, explicit issuer representations/promises and reasonable expectations of secondary-market purchasers

sec_docket_reconciliation.docket_correction: Coinbase's October 20 letter and Ripple's May 7 letter are on different SEC dockets. Coinbase is S7-2026-27; Ripple is S7-2026-09. Do not describe the Ripple letter as a comment on the proposed S7-2026-27 rule.

sec_docket_reconciliation.interpretation: The two November staff memoranda document meetings, not Commission endorsement, adoption or a final rule. S7-2026-27 remains proposed on the SEC page.

conclusion: Preserve both flow series as competing provider-specific measurements. Do not admit either aggregate to the prediction feature store until same-fund issuer holdings, row status, source timestamps, reconstruction flags and direct/indirect exposure are reconciled. Correct the SEC docket assignment: Coinbase S7-2026-27; Ripple S7-2026-09.
